# MyShirtsDope

> MyShirtsDope is an independent online apparel store selling shirts, hoodies, onesies, mugs, and accessories inspired by music, culture, and love — old school hip hop, R&B, soul, and pop culture designs for adults, youth, and toddlers. Checkout is powered by Shopify.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://myshirtsdope.com/): Brand landing page with the latest drops.
- [Shop](https://myshirtsdope.com/shop): Full product catalog with search and category filters (Shirts, Hoodies, Onesies, Accessories).
- Product pages: https://myshirtsdope.com/product/{id} — each product page includes name, price, description, sizes, colors, and Product structured data (JSON-LD).

## Key links

- [Sitemap](https://myshirtsdope.com/sitemap.xml): Every product page with last-modified timestamps.
- [About](https://myshirtsdope.com/about): The story behind the brand.
- [Contact](https://myshirtsdope.com/contact): Get in touch with the MyShirtsDope team.

## Notes for agents

- The catalog spans thousands of products across adult, youth, and toddler fits; the sitemap is the authoritative index.
- Prices are in USD. Availability and pricing come from Shopify and are reflected in each product page's structured data.
